walker.role: The mass of the horde: surrounds and pins.
walker.ai: Sight 15 m (90 degree cone), hearing 40 m, smell 10 m. Follows the sound of the others. Grabs, then bites.
walker.counter: Chokepoints, a shove plus a head blow, distance.

runner.role: Predator that breaks the group's formation.
runner.ai: Sight 30 m, hearing 50 m. Straight line, vaults low obstacles. A charge that knocks down and bites.
runner.counter: Shoot the legs, closed doors, sound decoys.
runner.voice: Short growl, a scream on sighting

crawler.ai: Sight 5 m, hearing 20 m. Hides in brush and under cars. Bites the ankle without grabbing.
crawler.counter: Flashlight, look at the ground, a stomp (40 on the head).

brute.ai: Sight 20 m, hearing 30 m. Damage x3 on doors. An arc blow that knocks down 2 m, with a 0.8 s warning. Head lowered: -40% headshot area.
brute.counter: Shoot when it lifts its head after the blow (1.2 s), fire, explosives.

sniffer.role: A hunter that follows a trail.
sniffer.ai: Smell 60 m, follows blood trails (wounded player, fresh zombies) and pulls up to 8 Walkers behind it. Sight 10 m.
sniffer.counter: A bandage to stop the bleeding, crossing water, a meat decoy.

leaper.role: Jumps over the group and knocks down whoever is behind cover.
leaper.ai: Sight 25 m, hearing 40 m. Leaps 6 m horizontally and 3 m up (hoods, low walls, roofs). The leap knocks the target down for 1.5 s. 5 s cooldown.
leaper.counter: Shoot it in mid-air (it does not dodge), stay by a tall wall, a shove on landing.

bloater.ai: Sight 10 m, smell 25 m. On death it bursts into a 4 m cloud: blinds for 5 s, doubles your scent trail and makes you cough.
bloater.counter: Shoot from afar, burst it in the middle of the horde, a mask.

stalker.ai: Plays dead among the bodies. Wakes if someone passes within 3 m or with their back turned. A 4 m/s pounce for 3 s, grabs from behind.
stalker.counter: Confirmation shots into the bodies; a real corpse has dull eyes. Enter in pairs.
stalker.voice: Silent; a joint click under 8 m

blind.ai: Cannot see. Hears shots at 80 m and steps at 6 m (crouched, 2 m). Goes straight to the source of the sound and attacks whatever it finds, even other zombies.
blind.counter: Walk crouched, throw a bottle to divert it, do not shoot without a suppressor nearby.

screamer.ai: Hearing 60 m, sight 25 m. On seeing someone it screams: calls everyone within 150 m and gives +20% speed for 30 s. Repeats every 20 s and flees combat.
screamer.counter: Kill it first and in silence (bow, suppressor), cut the line of sight.
screamer.voice: A 3 s scream heard at 100 m

charred.ai: Immune to fire. Its melee burns (3 damage per second for 4 s). At night it lights its surroundings and gives itself away. Water puts out the embers and takes 30% of its health.
charred.counter: Shoot from a distance, water, a fire extinguisher.

drowned.ai: Stays submerged in rivers, lakes and floods. Grabs whoever crosses and pulls them down: 3 s to break free or drowning starts. Slow out of the water.
drowned.counter: Bridges, a boat, shooting at the bubbles in the water.

devourer.ai: Looks for bodies that stay 15 min on the ground and eats: each gives +20 health and +5% size, up to 3 times. While eating it only sees 5 m. Defends its food.
devourer.counter: Burn or collect the bodies, attack while it eats.
